response.justification: Although Bogdan demonstrates exceptional software engineering capabilities with 16+ years of diverse development experience, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's requirements. Most critically, the job explicitly requires native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is entirely absent from the resume. Additionally, this embedded firmware security role demands deep expertise in security technologies (encryption, authentication, attack detection), Linux kernel investigation, and networking protocols—domains where Bogdan has no demonstrated experience. His background centers on web, mobile, and application development, whereas this position requires embedded systems and LAN-switch product development expertise.
strengths: Exceptional software engineering breadth with 16+ years of experience across multiple domains and programming languages demonstrating strong learning ability
C/C++ programming background from National Instruments with Linux exposure, providing some foundation for UNIX development
Strong DevOps, infrastructure, and development environment expertise (CI/CD, Docker, GitLab, deployment systems)
concerns: Critical blocker: No Japanese language proficiency listed, despite being an explicit required qualification for the role
No demonstrated experience with security technologies (MACsec, IEEE 802.1X, authentication systems, encryption, attack detection, tamper detection)

Career entirely focused on web, mobile, and application development; lacks embedded firmware, networking protocols, switch architecture, and kernel-level programming experience essential for LAN-switch products

key_factors.factor: No Embedded Systems or Security Domain Experience
Insufficient Linux Kernel and Networking Expertise
